subject: planner: fix unexpected decorrelate for LeftOuterJoin (#63211)
summary: Adds a guard (`skipDecorrelateProjectionForLeftOuterApply`) in `DecorrelateSolver` to skip decorrelation of `LeftOuterApply` when the inner `Projection` is all-constant or depends only on outer-side columns, which would otherwise break LEFT OUTER JOIN null-extension semantics (scalar subquery should return NULL when the inner produces no rows). Adds a regression test (issue #62937) and updates plan baselines; upstream/master retains this logic.
